{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Mirror (Russian: Зеркало , \"Zerkalo \" ; known in the United States as \"The Mirror\") is a 1975 Russian art film directed by Andrei Tarkovsky.","title":"The Mirror (1975 film)"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" It is loosely autobiographical, unconventionally structured, and incorporates poems composed and read by the director's father, Arseny Tarkovsky.","title":"The Mirror (1975 film)"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" The film features Margarita Terekhova, Ignat Daniltsev, Alla Demidova, Anatoli Solonitsyn, Tarkovsky's wife Larisa Tarkovskaya and his mother Maria Vishnyakova, with a soundtrack by Eduard Artemyev.","title":"The Mirror (1975 film)"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Voyage in Time (Italian: \"Tempo di Viaggio\" ) is a 63-minute feature documentary that documents the travels in Italy of the director Andrei Tarkovsky with the script writer Tonino Guerra in preparation for the making of his film \"Nostalghia\".","title":"Voyage in Time"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" In addition to the preparation of Nostalghia, their conversations cover a wide range of matters, filmmaking or not.","title":"Voyage in Time"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" Notably, Tarkovsky reveals his filmmaking philosophy and his admiration of films by, among others, Robert Bresson, Jean Vigo, Michelangelo Antonioni, Federico Fellini, Ingmar Bergman.","title":"Voyage in Time"}],"peer_messages":["Unverified peer answer: noanswer","Unverified peer answer: 1986\nEvidence: {\"sentence_id\":0,\"text\":\"The Sacrifice (Swedish: Offret ) is a 1986 Swedish film directed by Andrei Tarkovsky.\",\"title\":\"The Sacrifice\"}"],"previous_answer":"noanswer","question":"What year did Andrei Tarkovsky make the film whose making is documented in Voyage in Time?"}
